summary.text: C. Mia Pettus, a Libertarian Party candidate and former police officer and independent researcher, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 8th District to Kristen McDonald Rivet.

paragraphs.text: Pettus describes herself as a Michigan resident, Christian and mother. She is a former City of Philadelphia certified police officer and a former Department of Defense Navy civilian federal police officer, and she is an independent researcher who publishes the PALS Report on Substack.
She says her run for Congress was also shaped by personal experience, including building a business, financial hardship, parenting a child with a disability and periods of housing instability.
Pettus advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
During the campaign, she emphasized constitutional limits, government transparency and privacy protections.
She received 0.8% of the vote to Kristen McDonald Rivet's 55.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
